title: A trajectory's wait: the engine against the environment
description: Per-trajectory wait, from concurrent sums divided by rollout_trajectory_count. The raw sums run about 200x their own parent and must never be banded. `slowest` is what generate waits for. The engine wait also contains any driver-thread tokenization on the call path, so it is not purely engine time.

defaults.noValue: No rollout counters. This build does not instrument the generation coroutines.

params.value: WITH counters AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'counter') AS counter, MAX(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('rollout_wait_seconds', 'rollout_count') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'trainer' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), per_step AS ( SELECT bucket, s, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_trajectory_count' THEN value END) AS trajectories, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_engine_await_seconds_sum' THEN value END) AS engine_seconds, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_env_await_seconds_sum' THEN value END) AS env_seconds, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'rollout_engine_await_seconds_max' THEN value END) AS slowest FROM counters GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(engine_seconds / NULLIF(trajectories, 0)) AS engine_wait_per_trajectory, AVG(env_seconds / NULLIF(trajectories, 0)) AS env_wait_per_trajectory, AVG(slowest) AS slowest_single_trajectory FROM per_step GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
